methods: Read the fixed review brief and verified repository HEAD.
Inspected current HelpCenter, walkthrough source, career-guide presentation, auth recovery controls, README, operations and admin instructions.
Executed the exact exported searchHelpTopics function after in-memory TypeScript transpilation; analysis script is .tmp/20-role-review/10-technical-writer/help-search.cjs.
Listed five local MP4/VTT/TXT/poster sets and read production asset provenance; treated ready/playback claims as documentation claims rather than observed playback.
not_tested: Actual email delivery or recovery links
Current configured model, Gmail or scheduler availability
Local/public video playback, caption synchronization or human assessment of lip sync
Full test suite or newcomer usability study

criteria.name: First-task and repeat-task completeness
criteria.evidence: src/pages/HelpCenter.tsx:23-39 and 158-168 name actual six-step and second-application controls and renewed approval.

criteria.name: Plain language and factual boundaries
criteria.evidence: src/pages/HelpCenter.tsx:99-114 preserves context, contribution and result status; src/lib/career-guides.ts:28-32 discloses AI assistance and conditional connections.

criteria.name: Findability and recovery
criteria.evidence: Strong file/draft/run recovery content; exact search execution misranks resume and lost draft and returns no result for resume upload. No public account-access recovery topic.

criteria.name: Multimodal instruction integrity
criteria.evidence: Five MP4/VTT/TXT/poster sets exist. src/pages/Walkthroughs.tsx:27-32,72,81 supplies honest fiction/AI labels, chapters and written fallbacks. Playback not independently observed.

criteria.name: Maintenance and operator handoff
criteria.evidence: README.md:30-35,96-102 and ADMIN-PORTALS-GUIDE.md are concrete, but docs/OPERATIONS.md and parts of INTEGRATED-JOB-LOOP-OPERATIONS.md conflict with current scripts and admin procedures.

strengths: Exact first-check and another-vacancy instructions, with useful no-CV and upload alternatives.
Source context, team credit, estimates, eligibility and user confirmation are carefully distinguished.
Temporary recovery, cloud cancellation and account storage limits are described separately.
Five prerecorded AI-presenter assets have local captions/transcripts; source distinguishes capture stills and simulated Job Loop services from live execution.

findings.problem: Plausibly current operations documents contain obsolete setup commands, broad browser-state clearing and conflicting support/provider instructions, increasing avoidable setup and pilot support errors.

evidence.detail: Lists Node 18+; lines 14-37 use historical repository/install/database commands; lines 53-67 list scripts not present in package.json; lines 92-94 advise localStorage.clear().
Current scripts include typecheck, test:run and setup-db, not type-check, test:e2e, db:migrate or db:seed.
Requires Node 24 or supported Node 22 and npm ci; lines 96-102 explain reviewed additive migrations and prohibit replaying historical setup paths.
Directs support status work through Table Editor; line 34 says model adapters remain unavailable pending setup.
Documents audited portal support status actions; lines 3 and 44-50 provide dated connection evidence and current owner controls. These claims were not live-verified by this reviewer.

findings.recommendation: Mark historical entry guides explicitly, publish one canonical operations index, replace obsolete commands and broad storage purges, and attach verified date/feature-state source to current support and provider instructions.
acceptance_criteria: Every script in the active setup path exists and prerequisites match README.
A fresh maintainer completes install and non-mutating readiness checks using only the canonical index.
Support status instructions follow current audited portal controls.
Blanket localStorage clearing is not the default session-recovery action.
dependencies: Operator owner validates canonical procedure and current feature-state evidence without exposing credentials
findings.cost_effect: No additional service spend; reduces avoidable setup/support investigation. Savings are unmeasured.

findings.problem: Literal all-word matching fails ordinary candidate task language and can send resume searches toward cloud-run recovery despite existing CV upload help.

evidence.detail: Search checks every whitespace-separated literal word against concatenated topic content and ranks literal title matches.

Exact exported function execution: resume => job-loop-controls; resume upload => no matches; lost draft => job-loop-review; PDF and another vacancy return relevant existing topics. This was function execution, not browser observation.
CV file reading/upload help exists; interrupted draft recovery exists at line 184.

findings.recommendation: Add a small editorial alias and task-phrase map for resume/CV, upload/read file, lost/interrupted draft and login/sign-in; offer relevant task suggestions when no result matches.
acceptance_criteria: Resume upload ranks file-reading help first.
Lost draft ranks draft recovery first.
Existing exact-title and PDF searches remain useful.
Five pilot participants locate relevant help using their own task language.
findings.cost_effect: No external search or model service needed; editorial query mapping fits existing code.

findings.problem: Public help explains draft recovery but offers no dedicated password, missing-confirmation-email or expired-sign-in-link task for returning users seeking saved facts.

evidence.detail: Complete topic list through line 197 lacks an account-access recovery topic; recovery at lines 184-195 addresses drafts and saved records.
Exact search function returns no topics for forgot password, confirmation email and cannot log in.
Existing auth interface has reset/confirmation guidance and a Forgot your password action at line 170.
Existing invalid/expired reset-link state supplies same-browser instructions and a link to request another reset.
Guest contact receipt path is available without signup; delivery and service state were not live-tested.

findings.recommendation: Add one public account-access task that helps choose the existing Google/password route, links password reset, explains current missing/expired-email guidance and protects an open check; link the guest contact receipt fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Signed-out readers find the appropriate existing recovery action without creating another account.
Instructions match actual auth controls and the current same-browser reset requirement.
The topic preserves no-delivery-guarantee wording and warns against sharing credentials in support.
Pilot readers distinguish saved account records from temporary unsaved drafts.
findings.cost_effect: No new auth integration or incremental vendor cost.

open_questions: Which single operator index will supersede older setup and support instructions?
Which phrases do actual pilot users use when trying to recover a check or sign in?
Do current public media assets play with readable captions and successful transcript fallback on pilot phones? This reviewer did not observe playback.
do_not_build_now: Another paid avatar or media integration
Public API documentation for interfaces that are not public
Additional guide volume before maintenance and retrieval gaps are addressed
